title: Lock, version 0
description: How a managed repository pins the Athenaeum revision it uses and says what it takes from it. Written as TOML. Every key is listed here: an unknown key is an error, so a misspelt one fails instead of being ignored.

schema_version.description: The version of this schema the lock follows. A reader that does not know the version must refuse the lock.

source.description: Where Athenaeum is fetched from: a git URL.

rev.description: The release tag the repository is pinned at. A tag and not a branch, because a branch moves.

commit.description: The full commit the tag resolved to when the lock was written. A tag that later points elsewhere no longer matches, and is refused. Forty lower-case hexadecimal digits: an abbreviation is ambiguous.

skills.description: The skills taken from Athenaeum, by name. At least one.

harnesses.description: The agent runtimes the skills are linked for, so that each finds them where it looks.
